items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: I said, “Hey Ginger, how you doing man, this is Chuck Lamb I’m a pianist and I’d doing a gig in Vail, I’d like you to come up and play, it’s a jazz gig.” And he goes, “How much does it pay?” And he came up.

ctx.x: Sit down when you listen to it. What about Ginger Baker?

Ginger Baker man, holy cow. So that was my gig in Vail that I told you about, the club called Louie’s that I had for eight, nine years. And I was bringing all these different people in and somebody had told me, I think the club owner, this young dude, he said, “Do you know that Ginger Baker moved to Denver?” I go, “You’re kidding.” And he had a horse ranch or a horse farm, or whatever. And I said, “Oh cool I’ll call him and see if I can get him.” And I called a friend who had done some work on the farm, I call up…
